what_it_is: All Cars/Tracks, including the Pac-Man car unlocked. Also includes the Ridge Racer Turbo Mode save with all Cars/Tracks unlocked.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 2 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); together they hold 2 save(s), 2 for this game (BASLUS-90049 RIDGE60, BASLUSP00797RR4_GAME)
